title: S5 visible authoring demo: preregistration (frozen before any capture)

existing_viewer_inventory.gap_closed_how: No engine edit: the engine already displays arbitrary stage text verbatim; the harness feeds the board file with LIVE measured values and captures /glass in the visible browser

build_test_reuse_sequence: 1 BUILD: compile_transaction (s=1.0) -> MD01 upload -> pause -> /membrane_demo state -> board A text (live numbers) -> /frame + /glass
2 TEST: deform load_N=0.8 -> state -> board B text -> /frame + /glass; /project apex -> pick check
3 TEST: deform load_N=1.6 -> state -> board C text -> /frame + /glass
4 REUSE: S3 table lookup (no engine call) -> board D text with table-vs-engine rows -> /glass
5 FALSIFIER: compile at 0.9 N refused by the record -> board E text -> /glass
6 clean shutdown (process handle terminate + wait, never by name)

repeatability_law.per_state_frame_identity: the /frame PNGs of states A, B, C must be byte-identical across the two runs (sha256 equal; the increment-5 byte-identical precedent)
repeatability_law.readout_identity: the board JSON spec text (the on-screen readout) must be digit-for-digit identical across runs; the measured engine values (apex z, residual, energy) must be digit-for-digit identical (f32-deterministic engine, paused scene)
repeatability_law.glass_dynamic_pixels: /glass contains the status bar's fps/ms and the timeline clock, which tick - the glass is compared pixel-wise and the changed-pixel count is RECORDED (not required zero); the dynamic set must stay confined to the known clock/fps rows (measured in the probe)
repeatability_law.eta_digits: the S3 table digits are fixed constants; both runs print them identically

out_of_scope.human_usability: the gate column itself says 'human usability remains separately observed' - NOT chased here
out_of_scope.gpu: no GPU batch, no inference; engine runs are the established one-at-a-time capture pattern
out_of_scope.engine_edits: NONE; ChimeraEngine/engine/ui.cpp is pre-existing dirt and is not touched or staged
